extDescription: Each booster pack contains 4 random cards.

name: Zombie Master (Skill Card)
extDescription:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can choose 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster you control, and it gains the following effect while face-up on the field.
• Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster in either GY; Special Summon that target. This monster must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Terror from the Deep!
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase, while you control "Kairyu-Shin". When this Skill is activated, you can activate "Umi" directly from your hand, Deck or GY. While you control "Kairyu-Shin", all WATER monsters you control are unaffected by Trap effects. If "Kairyu-Shin" you control leaves the field, draw 2 cards, and if you do, flip this card over.

name: Dino Destruction
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per turn, you can choose 1 Level 6 or higher Dinosaur monster you control. This turn, if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. Flip this card over at the end of the turn you activated this Skill.

name: Cocoon of Ultra Evolution (Skill Card)
cleanName: Cocoon of Ultra Evolution Skill Card
extDescription:
Activate the following Skill(s) during your Main Phase.
• You can Tribute 1 Insect monster from either field equipped with an Equip Card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Insect monster from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, also flip this card over.
• You can shuffle 1 Insect monster from your GY into the Deck, then draw 1 card, also flip this card over.
Each of these Skills can only be used once per Duel.

name: Switcheroo
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per turn, you can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck, then draw 1 card, also flip this card over. You can use this Skill up to twice per Duel.

name: Magician of Black Chaos
extDescription: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Magic Ritual".

name: Black Magic Ritual
extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Magician of Black Chaos". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

name: Kairyu-Shin
extDescription: A sea dragon known as the King of the Ocean, it attacks its enemies with huge tidal waves.

name: Ancient Brain
extDescription: A fallen fairy that is powerful in the dark.

name: Wetha
extDescription: A spirit that controls rain and is capable of summoning hurricanes to blow the enemy away.

name: Change Slime
extDescription: A slime that can morph and adopt the shape and size of any monster it chooses.

name: Giant Mech-Soldier
extDescription: This monster swings an earth-shaking axe that cannot be blocked by a common sword.

name: Crazy Fish
extDescription: A flying fish that attacks with its pointed head.

name: Girochin Kuwagata
extDescription: Despite its small size, this monster has powerful jaws that can rip metal to shreds.

name: Metal Armored Bug
extDescription: A gigantic insect-like creature covered by thick armor. Everything in his path is destroyed.

name: Tainted Wisdom
extDescription: If this Attack Position card is changed to face-up Defense Position: Shuffle your deck.

name: Cyber Raider
extDescription:
If this card is Summoned: Activate 1 of these effects.
• Target 1 Equip Card on the field; destroy that target.
• Target 1 Equip Card on the field; equip that target to this card.

name: Patrician of Darkness
extDescription: You choose the attack targets for your opponent's attacks.

name: Maryokutai
extDescription: During your opponent's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Sasuke Samurai
extDescription: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster.

name: Don Zaloog
Helping Robo for Combat
extDescription: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card, then return 1 card from your hand to the bottom of the Deck.

name: Despair from the Dark
extDescription: If this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

name: Blood Sucker
extDescription: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the GY.

name: Black Ptera
extDescription: If this card is sent from the field to the GY, except by being destroyed by battle: Return it to the hand.

name: Flint Lock
extDescription: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Flint" in the Spell & Trap Zone; equip it to this card. During your Main Phase: You can target 1 "Flint" equipped to this card, and 1 face-up monster on the field, except this card; equip that "Flint" to that targeted monster. This card can only be equipped with 1 "Flint". While equipped with "Flint", this card is unaffected by the effect of "Flint", and cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Golden Ladybug
extDescription: During your Standby Phase; You can reveal this card in your hand, and it will remain revealed until the end of this turn; gain 500 LP.

name: Jurrac Spinos
extDescription: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Spinos Token" (Dinosaur/FIRE/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 0) in Attack Position to your opponent's field.

name: Jurrac Stauriko
extDescription: If this card is destroyed by battle: Special Summon 2 "Jurrac Tokens" (Dinosaur/FIRE/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, unless it is for a "Jurrac" monster.

name: Jurrac Herra
extDescription: When a Defense Position "Jurrac" monster you control, except "Jurrac Herra", is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY.

name: Shore Knight
extDescription: Once per turn, when the battle position of this face-up card on the field is changed: Send 1 WATER monster from your Deck to the GY.

name: The Legendary Fisherman II
extDescription: This card's name becomes "The Legendary Fisherman" while on the field or in the GY. While "Umi" is on the field, this card is unaffected by other monsters' effects. If this face-up card is destroyed by battle, or leaves the field because of an opponent's card effect while its owner controls it: You can add 1 Level 7 WATER monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Parasite Paranoid
extDescription: (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card from your hand to that target. The equipped monster becomes an Insect monster, cannot attack Insect monsters, also its effects that activate by targeting an Insect monster(s) are negated. You can only use this effect of "Parasite Paranoid" once per turn. If this Equip Card is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher Insect monster from your hand, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

name: Skull Knight
extDescription: "Tainted Wisdom" + "Ancient Brain"

name: Super War-Lion
extDescription: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "War-Lion Ritual".

name: War-Lion Ritual
extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Super War-Lion". You must also Tribute monsters from the field or your hand whose total Levels equal 7 or more.

name: Share the Pain
extDescription: Tribute 1 monster; make your opponent Tribute 1 monster (for no effect).

name: Flint
extDescription: A monster equipped with this card loses 300 ATK and cannot change its battle position or declare an attack. If this card is destroyed because the equipped monster is destroyed: Target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that monster.

name: Tail Swipe
extDescription: Target 1 Level 5 or higher Dinosaur monster you control; if that Dinosaur monster is still face-up on the field, choose up to 2 monsters your opponent controls that have a lower Level than it, or are face-down, and return them to the hand.

name: Double Cyclone
extDescription: Target 1 Spell/Trap you control and 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy them.

name: Surface
extDescription: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster in your GY; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position.

name: Bashing Shield
extDescription: Equip only to a Normal Summoned/Set monster . It gains 1000 ATK. You take no battle damage from attacks involving it.

name: Iron Draw
extDescription: If you control exactly 2 Machine Effect Monsters and no other monsters: Draw 2 cards. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you can only Special Summon once. You can only activate 1 "Iron Draw" per turn.

name: Time Machine
extDescription: When a monster is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon that monster to the same field it was on, in the same battle position it was in when destroyed.

name: Tutan Mask
extDescription: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated that targets exactly 1 Zombie monster on the field (and no other cards): Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Energy Drain
extDescription: Select 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 200 ATK/DEF for each card your opponent currently has in their hand, until the end of this turn.

name: Assault on GHQ
extDescription: Select 1 monster you control; destroy it, then send 2 cards from the top of your opponent's Deck to the GY.

name: Haunted Shrine
extDescription: If you control no monsters: Target 1 Zombie monster in your GY; Special Summon it. If you control no monsters: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Zombie monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but its effects are negated. You can only use 1 "Haunted Shrine" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

name: Sealing Ceremony of Suiton
extDescription: Once per turn: You can send 1 WATER monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish that target.

name: Waking the Dragon
extDescription: If this Set card in its owner's control has left the field because of an opponent's effect, and is now in the GY or banished: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck or Extra Deck.

name: Floodgate Trap Hole
extDescription: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Change that monster(s) to face-down Defense Position. Monsters changed to face-down Defense Position by this effect cannot change their battle positions.

name: Fusion Party!
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material.

name: Ritual Ceremony
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can reveal 1 Ritual Monster from your hand, then add 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand that can Ritual Summon that monster.

name: Low Blow
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can make 1 monster on the field lose 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

name: Digging for Gold
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can banish 3 cards from your GY, then draw 1 card.

name: Two-Headed King Rex
extDescription: A powerful monster whose two heads attack as one.

name: Jack's Knight
extDescription: A strong master swordsman. His loyalty is to justice, his duty to protect the weak.

name: Sphere Kuriboh
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can send this card from your hand to the GY; change the attacking monster to Defense Position. When you Ritual Summon, you can banish this card from your GY as 1 of the monsters required for the Ritual Summon.

name: Riryoku
extDescription: Target 2 face-up monsters on the field; halve the ATK of 1 monster, and if you do, add that lost ATK to the other monster. These effects last until the end of this turn.

name: Reinforcements
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.
